evidenceLayout: tmp/cmp-closeout/CMP-40/attempt-<n>/ holds one full log per verification command, each ending with an exit=<status> line. The Progress Log of impl-plans/active/cmp-40-closeout.md records every command, its exit status and its log path. tmp/ is gitignored and never listed in writePaths. A missing or truncated log is not a pass. A step blocked by the sandbox (network, ~/.cache/tree-sitter, localhost, full nextest, .git writes) is recorded as BLOCKED with the command, exit code and stderr; the orchestrator reruns it before commit.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits the accepted implementation, the CMP-40 docs and the plan archive after review, with an AGENTS.md 1-6 section commit message and no tool attribution. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge. Only wf/syntax-fmt is pushed; never main.
executionModel.retryPolicy: CMP-40 runs alone. If cargo reports a build-directory lock, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker. Never run npm install; do not change package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and a one-line intent snapshot in the CMP-40 Progress Log. After the edit, record the post-edit sha256. If the file drifted from the last recorded hash, stop and report. Never edit outside writePaths, except a sharedPath under a recorded material finding (Task 2). Formatting is limited to rustfmt on a single repaired .rs file (never `cargo fmt` without --check).
executionModel.serialReconciliation: CMP-40 is the serial reconciliation: it owns README.md, impl-plans/README.md, plan archiving, the two design status sentences and the full gate. cmp-dispatch.json is the session-226 record: it is moved unchanged to impl-plans/completed/ and is never dispatched again. This manifest stays in impl-plans/active/.
